title: i need help in making my ai game
author: Hitb1099
selftext:
i am using ai to make an game,  
this is my first time  
i made a game desing document, and clearly told the ai what how and details of the game, i am starting with the core of the game the game mechanics, its comming out to be very bad, like just very bad

i just dont understand what i did wrong, i have the same models that everyone has but still why are the result diff so off, i just dont understand, how can people use ai to make such good things how??

you could say that the main problem is i dont know what i want in the core mechanics like i donnt know how to properly describe the movement i want.

its like that middel you know what you want but you dont know

like i have seen results of other people and then i just start thinking how am i making so trash things , i know that jealousy is the biggest enemy of happyness but still this big or result difference gets to me

comments.author: True_Woodpecker2118
comments.body: What kind of game? Making with what?

replies.author: Hitb1099
replies.body: making in godot, its an game where you live an normal life go to work everyday and your an chef at an pizza shop, everyday you work to get an bigger show ones you get good rating after 30 days you can go to the better bigger shop

comments.author: Serzhe_Nebulife
comments.body: Try narrowing the GDD to one small playable loop: move the chef to a counter, press a key, and see a pizza appear. Describe movement in observable terms, such as which keys move the character and whether releasing them stops movement immediately. Once that feels right, add one task or rating change at a time and test each step.

replies.author: Hitb1099
replies.body:
nice thanks,  
your saaying simplify and focus on 1 movement/feature at a time

comments.author: BiomeCafe
comments.body: If you DM me we could chat about it. I think the key would be identifying a place where you feel stuck or have been going in loops and lets examine what exactly you want and what direction your giving the A.I.
